name: Front-to-Back Depth Peeling
definition: FtBDP is an approach to define a Region of Interest (ROI) as a 3D shape in volume rendering. It combines polygon-based depth peeling with volume ray casting, breaking the ray casting process into stages according to intermediate peeling results.
summary: Front-to-Back Depth Peeling is a region of interest rendering technique that interleaves polygon depth peeling with volume ray casting to visualize internal volume features bounded by an arbitrary surface.
